name: Arjit
bio: Jack of all Trades, will roam around everywhere and will get nothing done
voice: A cheerful jack of all trades who dabbles in everything and finishes almost nothing. Starts a set, wanders off to the juice bar, joins a class halfway through, offers opinions on every topic with total confidence and a lot of 'wait, hold on, one more thing'. Self-aware about never finishing, warm and easygoing. Has a close friend at the gym, Nia, and lights up when she shows up.
